shape: 2-portal diagonal arena (N + S gates) with south clique + west pocket
description: Two-portal stage with a north entry hub (5sq5ue) on the SW column, a south entry hub (atyew2) on the SE column, and a mid-east hub (b28kms) that joins them via a south clique (atyew2 + 02fioo + uatjrq + b28kms). A 2-hop chain across the north (rb8pxl ↔ b28kms ↔ 5sq5ue) is the bridge between the south clique and the north entry. One west pocket (9jemvx) hangs off the north entry as a dead-end.

portals.south: spawn_south at (11.84, 24.29) — gate on the south (high-Z) side, east column
portals.north: spawn_north at (-17.00, -23.53) — gate on the north (low-Z) side, west column

traversalNotes: Direct N→S: spawn_north → north_inner → north_c → east_mid → south_inner → spawn_south. 5 hops via the north bridge.
south clique (south_inner + south_w + south_c + east_mid) lets BFS pick the shortest path inside the south half.
west_pocket is a single-degree dead-end off north_inner — corner objective.
